metadata.title: OTalign benchmark predictions and HHsuite profiles (Bioinformatics 2026 submission)
metadata.description:
Per-pair predictions, search-result scores, and HHsuite HMM profiles used to produce the figures and tables in:

OTalign: Optimal-transport alignment of protein language model embeddings. Minsoo Kim et al., Bioinformatics (2026, in revision).

The deposit covers the alignment-task datasets (SABmark-sup, SABmark-sup_fp, SABmark-twi, SABmark-twi_fp, MALIDUP, MALISAM) and the ECOD30-hard homolog-discrimination benchmark, with results for OTalign (Ankh-Large, Ankh-Base, ESM-1b, ESM-2, ProtT5 backbones; 2-epoch LoRA fine-tune of ESM-1b), HHalign (global and local), NWalign, DeepBLAST, pLMAlign-ProtT5, pLM-BLAST, and EBA. See the embedded MANIFEST.txt for SHA-256 digests and README.md for a description of the layout.

Source code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/DeepFoldProtein/OTalign and archived on Zenodo separately.
